_about: What Nabeel said about a game and what was done about it, shown on the Game Review page (tools/review_page.py) as a green box on that game's card. His words are kept exactly as he wrote or said them. kind: 'yours' = his own review of this game; 'also' = the same fault found here from his review of another game.

police.said: In this game you're are supposed to be chasing a criminal but the game doesn't make it clear who the criminal is. Theirs should be a clear sign that this is the car. This is the only car you should be chasing. And once the criminal gets out to run the running graphics are just awful. Plus the skyscrapers randomly dissappear if you play the game for long enough Plus the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse and a city shouldn't be just a straight line but turn and corners
police.did: A red arrow and ring mark the suspect's car. A stick to steer, with GAS and BRAKE (hold BRAKE when stopped to reverse). A city of streets and corners. Runners with knees and elbows. The buildings no longer vanish.

police.said: make it clear how do you arrest them... there should be a button for arrest this person, and maybe you make it fun. You have to tap quicker than they're resisting... when you arrest someone, the graphics are kind of messed up... the person when running should also be able to turn corners, and I can turn corners
police.did: An ARREST button. A tapping fight with a bar: tap faster than he resists. The arrest picture rebuilt. The alleys have corners: swipe the way the yellow arrow points.

police.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
police.did: When his car is stopped you see him get out and run, and your officer get out after him.

police.said: It's ok as long as it actually gets more challenging in the higher levels because right now its just way too easy
police.did: Far levels now push on much further: a faster crook, thicker traffic and cars crossing, more blocked alleys and dead ends, a closer tackle and a harder struggle.

taxi.said: you're literally taking them just around the corner... let the people drive for at least for some time. I'm talking like 3 to 5 minutes at least... you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
taxi.did: A passenger goes right across town (7 to 10 blocks; it was one). A shift is about 4 to 5 minutes. You see them walk to the door, get in, sit in the back, get out and walk away.

taxi.said: the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse
taxi.did: You drive the taxi yourself: a stick, GAS and BRAKE. It used to drive itself.

pilot.did: The controls were upside-down (thumb down made the plane climb) and on the first flight up and down did nothing. Fixed, see the next box.

pilot.said: anytime I try to click the side button that'll take it up, it just takes me to the joystick... you have to make the joystick in a single location... If you press this one, it goes up in altitude. If you press this one, it goes down in altitude... left... right. That was fine. You don't need the joystick. But... when I tried to bring it down in altitude, it doesn't bring it down.
pilot.did: Four buttons that never move: UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT. Press and hold. No joystick. DOWN takes the plane down and UP takes it up, on every flight including the first.

hunter.said: Once again horrible animation with the animal and the spear throw. Plus the animal  just waits for me to kill it it should run away or even attack if I run or come too close or throw a spear. The animation must better fot animal and spear
hunter.did: New animals with real legs, necks, heads, ears and tails: they graze, look up, gallop off and fall. Come too close or run and a deer or horse bolts. A boar, bison or mammoth may charge: wait for DIVE ASIDE, push the stick sideways, then it stands winded for an easy throw. The throw: the arm whips forward, the spear leaves the hand with a streak and sticks in the animal or the ground.

hunter.said: in Hunter, you're supposed to tap left to face left, tap right to face right. But every time I tap, the joystick just goes there... for Hunter, the joystick should be in a set location... I would even recommend making it bigger... A lion attacked me and then it just left me alone? No... swipe to dodge... then tap to hit, tap to hit... I have to defeat that lion.
hunter.did: The stick is now fixed (bottom left) and a third bigger; a tap anywhere else never makes a stick. The lion is a fight: tap its side to face it, it leaps: SWIPE to dodge, it stumbles past you: TAP, TAP, TAP to spear it (its strength shows at the top). It turns and comes again until it is dead. If it gets you, you lose a chance and it is still there to fight.

vine.said: You have to do better on the animation animation hands and the person holding the vines and swinging overall the animation needs to better
vine.did: A new swinger with elbows, knees, hands and fingers. Both hands close on the vine. The legs kick forward and tuck back with the swing. In the air the arms reach for the next vine and the legs stride. A grab at nothing sends the arms wheeling.

vine.said: On Vine, the vines are disappearing. Where are they going? They shouldn't disappear... I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games... And the graphics are still bad.
vine.did: The vines were being cut away by the camera when close; now they never vanish (near the camera they fade a little and stay seen). The swing is now real: a rope that keeps its length, gravity, you pump with your legs to swing higher, no steering in the air, you catch where your hand meets the vine. The vine you let go swings back on its own. A new jungle: bark and leaves, ferns, mossy rocks, a waterfall, the tree house round a giant trunk.

vine.said: I cant see the vine that is supposed to be infront of me WTF make the vines I'm supposed to catch visable
vine.did: My fault: a missing starting value in the last update made every vine you hadn't grabbed yet invisible. Fixed: all the vines hang there again, and the next one glows gold with a NEXT VINE ring (an arrow at the edge when it's out of view).

reel.said: Make the fish clear currently its just a circle make the fish come out of the water in the place I'm supposed to put my fishing stick even is just briefly.  If you have bad eyes you won't even see the circle you are supposed to put make the circle distinct from the water color so its easy to see.
reel.did: Fish leap out of the water where you should cast. Each place is a bright orange ring with a dark edge and an arrow over it. The aim ring turns green and says ON THE FISH when it is on one. While you fight a fish you see it at the surface, with a ring round it.

reel.said: The big fish here sighn is not nessesary just the fishes coming out of the water is enough
reel.did: The arrows and FISH HERE words over the water are gone; the fish leaping out show where they are.

soar.said: The rings are ugly.  Make them nore pretty It doesn't even need to be a person flying you can just make a cape flying and flappy through the air. Make ghe surroundings really beautiful here its very important. Take your time renderings the surroundings. Make the game easier let me see the rings and be able to slowly go into them
soar.did: Rings of light with gems, each the next colour of the rainbow, and a trail of sparks leading to the next one. A crimson cape with a gold hem instead of a person. The surroundings: turquoise shallows and foam round the islands, flower meadows, blossom trees, palms, hot-air balloons, sailing boats, heaped clouds, a rainbow. Easier: you fly at half the speed on the first flights, the rings are bigger and closer, the trail is straighter.

run.said: the car controls should be a joystick with a button for break acceleration anf reverse and a city shouldn't be just a straight line but turn and corners
run.did: A stick, GAS, BRAKE and a NITRO button. A city of streets and corners with green arrows to the drop. Alleys with corners on foot.

run.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
run.did: At DITCH THE CAR you see yourself get out and run.

bus.said: you don't animate the person entering the car, nor do you animate them leaving the car
bus.did: The people getting off are seen stepping down from the door and walking away. They were only a number.

drone.said: The rings are ugly.  Make them nore pretty
drone.did: The hoops were one plain tube each. Each is now a gate of light: a neon core, a glow, a halo, and lamps that chase round it; each hoop is the next colour.

drone.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
drone.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
drone.did: A crash jumped the drone at once to the restart spot. Now you see it bounce off, tumble and fall, then it is put back.

drone.said: As long as it gets more challenging as the levels go up but currently its ok.
drone.did: Far levels now keep getting harder: smaller hoops further apart, stronger wind and gusts, more moving hoops, more trees, less time.

rope.said: You have to do better on the animation animation hands and the person holding the vines and swinging
rope.did: The walker was the same pill on two sticks, with arms fixed in the air. He is now a person with elbows, knees and hands, both hands closed on the pole, placing one foot in front of the other; he flails when he falls.

rope.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
rope.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
rope.did: The walker fell at a steady speed. Now he falls faster and faster; the view goes dark before you are back on the wire.

balloon.said: make the circle distinct from the water color so its easy to see
balloon.did: The target's rings were thin and washed out by the haze. They are wider, a stronger red, with a dark edge, and drawn without haze.

rex.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
rex.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
rex.did: A tree between the camera and the rex was cut away. Now it turns see-through and stays seen.

rex.said: With Rex the movments are not accurate at all. The joystick is not working i go left is goes somewhere else
rex.did: The stick used to turn him like a tank: left spun him on the spot and the camera swung round with him. Now he goes the way you push, as you see it on the screen: left is left, down turns him round to walk towards you. While your thumb is on the stick the view holds still, so left stays left; let go and it swings back behind him.

rex.said: you still haven't fixed Rex. Number one, how about you make the joystick in one place, not everywhere I tap... make it that I can be able to see around the area just by clicking the screen and moving around... you still haven't fixed the joystick problem... That T-Rex looks like shit... Make him look like an actual T-Rex.
rex.did: Found it with real finger touches: the view drifted while you walked, so your push and his path didn't match. Now the stick stays in one place (bottom left), the view never turns by itself, and you drag anywhere else to look round (both thumbs together works). A new T-Rex: a deep skull with teeth and brows, a thick S-neck, heavy body, huge thighs, bird-like feet, tiny two-fingered arms, a long tail, pebbly scales, dark back and pale belly.

kingdom.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
kingdom.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
kingdom.did: A kart in the air could still be steered, and one that went over the edge stopped dead in the air and sank slowly. Now it keeps its line in the air (a glider still steers) and falls faster and faster; the view goes dark before you are put back.

stunt.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
stunt.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
stunt.did: A kart in the air could still be steered. Now it keeps the line it took off on; the glider still steers.

surf.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
surf.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
surf.did: In the air your speed changed with the angle of the board. Now you keep the speed you took off with.

splash.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
splash.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
splash.did: You could steer in mid-jump. Now the jump goes where you aimed it when you left; after a splash the view goes dark before the checkpoint.

sandworm.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
sandworm.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
sandworm.did: When you fell, the worm froze where it was, even in the air. Now it runs on without you and you fly off on a real arc.

climb.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
climb.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
climb.did: A fall was a steady slide down. Now it is a real fall until the rope catches you, then the bounce.

skydive.when: from what you said about Vine (no impossible physics)
skydive.said: I don't want any impossible physics in any of these games. So check the games for impossible physics.
skydive.did: You fell 3 to 4 times faster than gravity out of the door. Now it is gravity and air: you speed up, then level off.

wolf.said: Running graphics are absolutely horrible. Fix the Running graphics on all animals. Now its just vibrating
wolf.did: The legs were stiff sticks swinging about 11 times a second (tied to the frame rate). Every animal (your wolf, the pack, the elk) is now a jointed animal with shoulders, knees and hocks, galloping at a real stride rate (2 to 3 strides a second).

castle.said: AMAZING GAME!!!! but just a little too hard on the earlier levels ramp it slowly once the player is an expert then you can make it more challenging
castle.did: From level 4 the climb is slower: weaker foes, smaller armies and longer gaps between waves, reaching full strength only by level 22.

heaven.said: We can't tell people what to think morally; this isn't a game you can win... dont rank the good or evil... just allow people to send the individuals where they like no winning here just move on to the next level
heaven.did: No halos or horns, no right or wrong gate, no lives, no sunset, no stars. You send each soul where you think; the Book can always be read; when the queue is empty the next day comes, with where you sent them.

vet.said: All tools and interactions—including the brush, needle and tweezers—must register reliably... If the animal becomes too nervous, immediately end the round and display: You failed. You made the animal too nervous. Offer a retry button.
vet.did: Tools now find the sore spot from twice as far, a nervous animal no longer ignores a tool, a normal pull never counts as a yank, and a brush stroke only counts as 'against the hair' when it clearly is. Too nervous: the round ends at once with YOU FAILED, 'You made the animal too nervous', and TRY AGAIN.

potter.said: Fix controls make sure it can actually be beat by a human otherwise its good
potter.did: Your finger had to land exactly on the clay's edge or it did nothing. Now it grabs the wall at that height wherever it lands: slide out to widen, in to narrow. Robot players of every skill win it (an ordinary one levels 1-20).
